title: Gooey Gradient Background
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.visual_review: Desktop and mobile screenshots inspected against supplied implementation.

asset_issues.issue: File absent at the path specified by TASK.md.
asset_issues.resolution: Built from full PROMPT.md reference code; no screenshot asset was used. Image comparison unavailable.

notes: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, lucide-react; bundled Dongle 300/400 with SIL OFL license.
Preserves five gradient animations, SVG goo filter, colors, centered Bubbles copy, and two glass buttons.
Mouse/touch following uses elapsed-time smoothing for lower frame rates; reduced-motion and animation cleanup are implemented.
Get Started reveals a pointer hint; Learn More opens a dismissible native dialog.
Headless software rendering of full-screen SVG blur layers can be slow; real device GPU performance was not measured.
No deployment, push, agents, or other design sessions. Ready means ready for review.
